title: ocean-schedules
description: Compare ocean carrier sailing schedules, transit times, and on-time reliability before you book.
summary: Compare ocean carrier sailing schedules, transit times, and on-time reliability before you book.
offersHint: Compare ocean carrier sailing schedules, transit times, and on-time reliability before you book. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.schedulesmcp.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: compare_lanes
toolsPreview.description: Compare ocean carriers serving an origin→destination port pair, ranked by on-time reliability and transit time. Use this to decide which line to book.

toolsPreview.name: carrier_reliability
toolsPreview.description: On-time performance and delay distribution for a specific carrier (by SCAC), optionally on a given lane.

toolsPreview.name: transit_time
toolsPreview.description: Observed transit-time distribution (median / p90, in days) for a carrier on an origin→destination lane.

toolsPreview.name: find_sailings
toolsPreview.description: Observed and derived upcoming departures on an origin→destination lane, with carrier and frequency.

toolsPreview.name: get_schedules
toolsPreview.description: Published forward sailing schedules on an origin→destination lane: carrier, vessel, voyage, ETD/ETA and cut-offs, soonest first. Sourced from carrier connectors (and aggregator coverage). Use this to find concrete upcoming departures to book.

toolsPreview.name: find_best_sailings
toolsPreview.description: Decision query: the best upcoming sailings on a lane, ONE per carrier (next bookable departure), ranked. Filter by date window, max transit days, min on-time reliability, cut-off still open, and direct-vs-transshipment. Use this to answer "what should I book?".

toolsPreview.name: watch_lane
toolsPreview.description: Watch a lane for schedule alerts (PAID): get emailed when a sailing on it is blanked, a booking cut-off is about to close, or a sailing slips. Also alerts on reliability drops. Returns the created watch.

toolsPreview.name: port_reliability
toolsPreview.description: Congestion and dwell signals for a port (UN/LOCODE) — average wait and vessels at anchor.

toolsPreview.name: carrier_league
toolsPreview.description: Carrier league table — ocean carriers ranked by overall on-time reliability across all tracked lanes.

toolsPreview.name: port_congestion
toolsPreview.description: Fused port-congestion signal for a port (UN/LOCODE): effective level (mild/moderate/severe), expected added wait in days (for ETA-band widening), a 0–1 confidence, and per-source detail — weiyun broad-AIS analysis + IMF PortWatch throughput + our own AIS wait/density.

toolsPreview.name: active_cyclones
toolsPreview.description: Live tropical cyclones (typhoons/hurricanes) currently active on ocean trade lanes — name, basin, category, center position, max wind, pressure and movement, from CMA (NW-Pacific) + NHC (Atlantic/E-Pacific) + JTWC (Indian/Southern Hemisphere) + GDACS (global). Use this to see which storms are at sea right now.

toolsPreview.name: lane_storm_exposure
toolsPreview.description: Whether an origin→destination ocean lane currently passes through an active cyclone's forecast gale field (a "storm-exposed" sailing at risk of weather delay). Omit ports to list every exposed lane.
